I've fixed it: `replace()` now gets the same size check before it runs that `replaceAll()` already had in native expression evaluation.

**Cause:** `assertPreflightSize` in `packages/workflow/src/expressions/native-evaluation/evaluator.ts` only checked `replaceAll()`. A `replace()` call has no loop, but its replacement string can contain `$'` or `` $` ``, which copy the text after or before the match into the result. So one call like `bigger.replace('', "$'$'$'$'$'$'$'")` builds a string many times the size of its input on the main thread. The existing check on the finished result only runs after that memory has already been used.

**Fix:** the `replaceAll` branch now covers `replace` too:
- If the replacement contains `$`, the expression goes to the engine, as `replaceAll` already did.
- Otherwise the size limit for `replace` is `receiver.length + replacement.length`, since arguments are always primitives and so only one match can be replaced. This is tighter than the `replaceAll` formula, so normal large `replace()` calls still run natively.

One behaviour change: `replace()` calls whose replacement contains `$` (for example `$&`) now always go to the engine, even small ones. The result is the same, just slower.

**Tests** (`packages/workflow/test/native-evaluation-corpus.ts`):
- Added `name.replace('o', '$`')` to the "falls back at runtime" list. Before this change it was evaluated natively, so this test would have failed.
- Added `bigger.replace('', "$'$'$'$'$'$'$'")` to the same list. It would also have fallen back before, through the after-the-fact check, so it doesn't prove the new check.
- Added `bigger.replace('', filler)` to the "evaluated natively" list. This guards against `replace` being sized with the much larger `replaceAll` formula.

**Verification:**
- `acdc-test test/native-evaluation-parity.test.ts test/native-evaluation-corpus-coverage.test.ts`: 4 files, 368 tests, all passed.
- `acdc-lint` on the two changed files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `acdc-typecheck`: one error, in `src/nodes-api-version.ts:49`, a file this change doesn't touch.
